args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks (error rate 0.18) in all production regions after the v2.3.1 deploy. Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** checkout-api: it was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: the deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was a staging build).

3. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions — verified successful.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.
